leftEvidence.title: Written things and an uncomprehended saying

points.label: Action and sequence
points.left: Jesus takes the Twelve, connects what is coming with the prophets, names treatment by Gentiles and death, and the disciples do not understand.
points.right: As the group goes up to Jerusalem, Jesus again takes the Twelve and states a sequence of condemnation, delivery, mockery, abuse, death, and rising.

points.label: Evidence boundary
points.left: This witness selects its own people, actions, words, and sequence around the Crucifixion without explaining every difference from the other witnesses.
points.right: This witness selects its own people, actions, words, and sequence around the Crucifixion without explaining every difference from the other witnesses.

payload.posture: Luke and Mark preserve closely placed road predictions while Luke explicitly names prophetic writing and lack of understanding.
payload.tension: One witness emphasizes what remains hidden from the Twelve; the other expands the sequence of human actions.
payload.title: Prophetic frame / narrated sequence
